datasheet_identity.title: AP2310GN-HF N-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: The AP2310GN-HF is an N-channel device. Electrical characteristics are specified at TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise stated.

RDS(on) is 70 mOhm typical and 90 mOhm maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 3 A; and 90 mOhm typical and 120 mOhm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 2 A. The strict schema records the typical targets and preserves maximums in this note.
The output-curve points are manual digitizations of real curves in p. 3 Fig. 1; no fitted or interpolated vendor SPICE data was used.

The datasheet publishes Ciss = 550 pF typical, 880 pF maximum at VGS = 0 V; Coss = 70 pF typical at VDS = 15 V; and Crss = 50 pF typical at f = 1 MHz. The capacitance plot is a usable generic terminal-capacitance curve but the strict schema stores the tabulated values.

The body-diode specification is VSD maximum 1.2 V at IS = 1.2 A, VGS = 0 V; reverse recovery is 25 ns typical at IS = 3 A, VGS = 0 V and Qrr is 26 nC typical at di/dt = 100 A per microsecond. The schema has no separate trr or Qrr fields.
